data.name: SteamMetadataSummary
data.value: Description, genres, developer, release date, tags and age ratings · no key

data.name: SteamMetadataAbout
data.value: Arcadia reads genres, developer, publisher, release date and tags right away from Steam’s own files. It fetches the description and age ratings once per game from Steam’s store page. Without a key, Steam accepts about 200 requests in 5 minutes; Arcadia stays below that. Steam only learns the game’s AppID, no account and no name.
